description: SaaS pricing: centered hero, three tiers with escalating elevation, one filled primary CTA on the featured tier.

referenceProfile.thesis: Elevation is the pricing narrative: the featured tier literally rises above the others with the deepest shadow and the only filled CTA.
signatureMoves: Three tiers escalate from flat, to raised, to lifted-with-accent so the recommended plan reads first.
Only the featured tier gets a filled primary button; the others stay outlined.
transferPreserve: Keep the elevation ladder and the single filled CTA per comparison group.
transferAvoid: Do not give every tier the same shadow or the same button weight — the hierarchy is the point.
